title: Tenma Tsukasa — A Persistent Game Of Tag〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Coast

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
All of you, wait here!
I'm going to head over to guide the helicopter!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew... We can finally get off this island...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, so all that's left is to make our ambassadorial performance a success after being postponed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Phone, I beg you... Even just a moment of life will do...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We haven't been able to talk to KAITO or the others since last night, so it'd be nice to tell them that help has arrived...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
They're probably really worried about us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If its battery being drained is the only issue, can't you just have Robo-Nene recharge it for you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! She can do that?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. However, your phone may short out the second you connect it to her.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But not being able to tell KAITO and the others that we're okay...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I don't care what happens.
Rui, let's give it a shot!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay...
Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Understood!
Commencing charge sequence.
Please connect this cord to your phone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay! Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, it's charging!
Does this mean it's working?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Hang in there, phone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <Oh, is our connection back?!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line:
<I think so!
Hello! Tsukasa! Everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That sounded like MEIKO and KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
<I'm here too!
But it's so dark! I can't see where you guys are!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The hologram feature must be malfunctioning.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It did take a swim in the ocean after all. Tsukasa, it may be wise to say what you need to and turn off your phone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
MEIKO, KAITO, Miku!
Please tell the others that we're all safe!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A helicopter just came to rescue us too! So, we should be able to get off this island and go do our show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: <Your show?! It's really happening?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that seems to be the case.
We've come this far, so we're going to give it everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, we likely won't be able to visit you until we get our phones fixed.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <That's okay! We'll be waiting for you all to return to us happy and healthy♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We absolutely really, really promise to visit when we can, so please wait for us until then!

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Okay! See you then☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad we got a chance to tell them that we're okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So am I! Let's make sure our ambassadorial performance goes well so that we have good news to report the next time we see them!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.
bgm_area00004
A few days later
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, KAITO!
Tsukasa and the others are here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you all seem to be in high spirits.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because we are! We already told Miku and MEIKO this on the day our phones were fixed and returned to us...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we'd like to report that our ambassadorial performance was a triumphant success!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, we awaited your return knowing that it would be. So, everyone, welcome back.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Or... Is it a bit strange for me to be saying that...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I'm really glad you did!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it does feel a bit funny.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, once more!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Everyone, we're back!

rows.Speaker: KAITO & Co.
rows.Line: Welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna hear more about your show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, we even got to do some water skiing after our show was over♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I decided to give it a try too after working up enough courage, but it turned out to be pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's wonderful. We'd love to hear more.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we'll tell you all about it!
